say:3:1220301003:0.text: If you don't have enough fingers, have someone else help you.
say:3:1220301003:0.source_cn: 你自己的手指头要是不够掰，赶紧找边上的人再借一只手。

say:4:1220301004:0.text: Yes, sir! I'll use my toes, too.

say:5:1220301005:0.text: You got a smart mouth, don't you? Where's the fella that's going to buy the rat poison?
say:5:1220301005:0.source_cn: 别耍聪明。买老鼠药的人什么时候回来？

say:6:1220301006:0.text: Sir, that's me! I just finished my work... I'll head out right now.
say:6:1220301006:0.source_cn: 二当家！我刚忙完……我马上去！

say:7:1220301007:0.text: Remember this time! We need rat poison, not rat pellets. If you buy rodent feed again, that'll be your dinner for the rest of the year!
say:7:1220301007:0.source_cn: 这回要是再买成老鼠饲料，那玩意就是你未来一年的晚餐！

say:8:1220301008:0.text: You new fish don't know anything! How are you going to help Sonja if you're all as dumb as a snail?
say:8:1220301008:0.source_cn: 这些笨手笨脚的新人，什么时候才能给索尼娅分忧？

say:10:1220301009:0.text: You know, Lucca, it takes a very special person to find rodent feed in a dingy place like this.
say:10:1220301009:0.source_cn: 能找到卖老鼠饲料的地方，也是一种本领啊，卢卡。

say:13:1220301011:0.text: A rodent infestation just broke out in Rustport. It's got everyone on edge.
say:13:1220301011:0.source_cn: 这几天锈锚港在闹鼠患，搞得大家都人心惶惶。
say:13:1220301011:0.male: A rodent infestation just broke out in Rustport. It's got everyone on edge.
say:13:1220301011:0.female: A rodent infestation just broke out in Rustport. It's got everyone on edge.

say:14:1220301012:0.text: I'm not talking about your two lackeys there. Rats have been coming out of the woodwork, and people are worried that a new plague might start.
say:14:1220301012:0.source_cn: ——不是指你的两个跟班，而是那些可能引发新一轮鼠疫的耗子。
say:14:1220301012:0.male: I'm not talking about your two lackeys there. Rats have been coming out of the woodwork, and people are worried that a new plague might start.
say:14:1220301012:0.female: I'm not talking about your two lackeys there. Rats have been coming out of the woodwork, and people are worried that a new plague might start.

say:16:1220301013:0.text: Was there ever a plague in Rustport before?
say:16:1220301013:0.source_cn: 锈锚港曾经爆发过鼠疫吗？

say:17:1220301014:0.text: Yes, there was a plague related to a dark mage.
say:17:1220301014:0.source_cn: 那场鼠疫与黑魔法师有关。

say:18:1220301015:0.text: It's said that the dark mage was experimenting with disease-inducing mice, but they escaped and were later eaten by sea birds. These birds were then captured by hunters and fishermen and served at dinner tables all over Rustport.
say:18:1220301015:0.source_cn: 黑魔法师培育出了致病的老鼠，没想到那群老鼠逃出笼子，被...

say:19:1220301016:0.text: Death lurked in every bite, and finally, it got out of control.
say:19:1220301016:0.source_cn: 死亡潜藏在食欲中，最后……一发不可收拾。

say:20:1220301017:0.text: Many people died during that time. It's been more than a century, but that fear still lingers in Rustport.
say:20:1220301017:0.source_cn: 当时死了不少人，虽然过去一百多年了，但那种恐惧还留在大...

say:21:1220301018:0.text: A dark mage, huh? Yes, they were indeed rampant during those days. I didn't know that even Rustport was affected.
say:21:1220301018:0.source_cn: 黑魔法师啊……那个年代，黑魔法师的确很猖狂，没想到连锈...

say:22:1220301019:0.text: Mr. Lucca, what's your plan going forward?
say:22:1220301019:0.source_cn: 卢卡先生，你现在打算怎么办？

say:23:1220301020:0.text: Right now, the rats have ruined a couple of warehouses full of supplies. I'm taking my men to see what we have left, do some inventory, and then buy supplies to fill the gaps.
say:23:1220301020:0.source_cn: 老鼠糟蹋了好几个仓库，我正带人挨个清点，之后好统一采购...

say:24:1220301021:0.text: The problem is our new recruits are as dumb as a starfish. Progress is slow.
say:24:1220301021:0.source_cn: 但那几个新入伙的，脑袋不太灵光……进度堪忧。

say:25:1220301022:0.text: I've been busy since yesterday, and there's still one place I haven't gone to yet.
say:25:1220301022:0.source_cn: 从昨天忙到现在，我还有一处没来得及去。

say:27:1220301023:0.text: Magister! Can Chippy help with this?
say:27:1220301023:0.source_cn: 主人！能让满满帮忙调查吗？
say:27:1220301023:0.male: Magister! Can Chippy help with this?
say:27:1220301023:0.female: Magister! Can Chippy help with this?

choice_prompt:28:1220301023.text: Magister! Can Chippy help with this?
choice_prompt:28:1220301023.source_cn: 主人！能让满满帮忙调查吗？
choice_prompt:28:1220301023.male: Magister! Can Chippy help with this?
choice_prompt:28:1220301023.female: Magister! Can Chippy help with this?

say:29:1220301024:0.text: Great! Chippy will do this in the name of the magister!
say:29:1220301024:0.source_cn: 太好了！满满一定要捍卫主人的名誉！
say:29:1220301024:0.male: Great! Chippy will do this in the name of the magister!
say:29:1220301024:0.female: Great! Chippy will do this in the name of the magister!

say:30:1220301026:0.text: Lucca said that the old plague was related to the dark mage.
say:30:1220301026:0.source_cn: 刚刚卢卡说，当年的鼠疫与黑魔法师脱不开干系。
say:30:1220301026:0.male: Lucca said that the old plague was related to the dark mage.
say:30:1220301026:0.female: Lucca said that the old plague was related to the dark mage.

say:31:1220301027:0.text: You're a mage that just arrived at Rustport. If a plague breaks out again...
say:31:1220301027:0.source_cn: 同样身为魔法师的主人刚来锈锚港不久，要是这个时候再次爆...
say:31:1220301027:0.male: You're a mage that just arrived at Rustport. If a plague breaks out again...
say:31:1220301027:0.female: You're a mage that just arrived at Rustport. If a plague breaks out again...

say:33:1220301028:0.text: Oh, I see... You're worried that someone might spread rumors about the magister, saying that <style="stress"><player_name></style> brought the plague to Rustport.
say:33:1220301028:0.source_cn: 原来如此……你怕有人在背后造谣，说是<style=st...
say:33:1220301028:0.male: Oh, I see... You're worried that someone might spread rumors about the magister, saying that <style="stress"><player_name></style> brought the plague to Rustport.
say:33:1220301028:0.female: Oh, I see... You're worried that someone might spread rumors about the magister, saying that <style="stress"><player_name></style> brought the plague to Rustport.

say:34:1220301029:0.text: Yes, it is possible indeed. I can't believe you used your brain for once.
say:34:1220301029:0.source_cn: 确实很有可能，满满！想不到你也学会动脑筋了呢。

say:35:1220301030:0.text: Ha! Chippy is learning. Chippy always tries to think, "What would Hammie do in this situation?"
say:35:1220301030:0.source_cn: 嘿嘿，其实我只是在学你。如果是漫漫，可能会这样替主人考...
say:35:1220301030:0.male: Ha! Chippy is learning. Chippy always tries to think, "What would Hammie do in this situation?"
say:35:1220301030:0.female: Ha! Chippy is learning. Chippy always tries to think, "What would Hammie do in this situation?"

say:36:1220301031:0.text: Hmph, I guess I just have to work harder from now on. I don't even want to imagine being surpassed by you.
say:36:1220301031:0.source_cn: 哼，那我得加把劲了，可不能被你超过呀。

say:37:1220301032:1.text: Mr. Lucca, where is the warehouse you mentioned? Chippy and I will go help.
say:37:1220301032:1.source_cn: 卢卡先生，你说的仓库在哪？我和满满去帮你看看吧。

say:41:1220301035:0.text: The last warehouse is <style="highlight">south of here, near the city gates</style>. I'll leave it to you.
say:41:1220301035:0.source_cn: 最后一个仓库在<style=highlight>南边的...
say:41:1220301035:0.male: The last warehouse is <style="highlight">south of here, near the city gates</style>. I'll leave it to you.
say:41:1220301035:0.female: The last warehouse is <style="highlight">south of here, near the city gates</style>. I'll leave it to you.

say:43:1220301037:0.text: This coin is what the Carmine Whispers use to identify each other.
say:43:1220301037:0.source_cn: 这是我们血薇帮用来证明身份的硬币。
say:43:1220301037:0.male: This coin is what the Carmine Whispers use to identify each other.
say:43:1220301037:0.female: This coin is what the Carmine Whispers use to identify each other.

say:44:1220301038:1.text: If anyone tries to stop you, show them this, and they'll know who's got your back.
say:44:1220301038:1.source_cn: 要是有人拦你们的路，把这个拿给他们看，他们会知道是谁给...
say:44:1220301038:1.male: If anyone tries to stop you, show them this, and they'll know who's got your back.
say:44:1220301038:1.female: If anyone tries to stop you, show them this, and they'll know who's got your back.

say:46:1220301034:0.text: Thanks. Now I see why Sonja has her eye on you.
say:46:1220301034:0.source_cn: 好，不愧是能和索尼娅并肩作战的魔法师！
say:46:1220301034:0.male: Thanks. Now I see why Sonja has her eye on you.
say:46:1220301034:0.female: Thanks. Now I see why Sonja has her eye on you.

say:47:1220301025:0.source_cn: 因为……满满担心主人的名誉会因此受损。

say:47:1220301025:0.female: Because Chippy's worried that everyone will think this is happening because of the magister...
